missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Молчание' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'было'. 'Полное' is the agreeing neuter adjective. A natural way to describe a quiet scene.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Молчание' is the accusative direct object of 'понимаю', identical to the nominative for neuter nouns. 'Его' marks the possessor. An interpretive pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive after от. 'Молчания' is genitive, governed by 'от'. 'Долгого' agrees in the neuter genitive. Expresses the source of tiredness.
Strategic focus: Dative after удивиться. 'Молчанию' is dative, governed by 'удивились'. 'Его' marks the possessor. A useful emotion-verb pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Молчанием' is instrumental, expressing the manner of the reply. 'Долгим' agrees in the neuter instrumental. A vivid expressive pattern.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Молчании' is the prepositional form after 'в'. The phrase 'что-то тревожное' is the nominative subject. A literary, reflective sentence.
Strategic focus: Genitive modifier. 'Молчания' is genitive, modifying 'минута' in the fixed phrase a minute of silence. 'Память' is the accusative object. A formal commemoration pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with accusative experiencer. 'Молчание' is nominative, the thing that frightens. 'Меня' is the accusative experiencer of 'пугает'. 'Долгое' agrees in the neuter.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Молчания' is the nominative plural subject of 'бывают', here meaning recurring silences. 'Между нами' gives the setting. A literary plural use.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Молчания' is the accusative plural object of 'тревожат', identical to the nominative plural for neuter nouns. 'Эти долгие' agree in the plural.
